about_the_game:
Your Dutch journey is just one click away! Step into the charming world of the Netherlands as the Collins family embarks on an unforgettable journey to celebrate their anniversary. From the bustling streets of Amsterdam to the colorful flower fields of Keukenhof, every moment is filled with unity, exploration, and joy. Cruise the canals at sunset, climb to the top of the Euromast, and lose yourself in the timeless magnificence of castles and windmills. Along the way, engage with interactive puzzles, explore hidden secrets, and collect unique souvenirs that make each step captivating.

This Collector's Edition includes:

🔎 Interactive Exploration!

Embark on a virtual tour through iconic Dutch landmarks, including the windmills of Kinderdijk, the canals of Amsterdam, and the historic streets of Delft. Each location is richly detailed, offering unique stories and surprises that bring Dutch culture to life!

🔎 Challenging Puzzles!

Test your problem-solving skills with a variety of puzzles and brain teasers, ranging from pattern-matching games and logic challenges to clever riddles. Every puzzle is woven into the story, adding depth and excitement to your journey!

🔎 Hidden Object Fun!

Dive into beautifully crafted scenes filled with intricate details as you search for hidden objects. From antique markets to vibrant tulip fields, each scene offers a fresh challenge and a chance to uncover secrets hidden in plain sight!

🔎 Collectible Souvenirs!

Collect unique keepsakes from every destination, including handcrafted ceramics, miniature windmills, and traditional Dutch clogs. These souvenirs not only mark your progress but also unlock fun facts and insights about Dutch heritage and traditions!
